contexts.text: A nation from the extremity of the earth () = evils and falsities.
End or extremity = a little... The extremity, here, is what is called the circuit...
These are the extremities of order.
From the extremity of the heavens to the extremity of them () = the internal and external things of the Church. AE 418:5.
The fly in the extremity of the rivers of Egypt () = the falsities which are in the extremes of the natural mind... AC 7442:2. AE 410:6.
The locust = falsity in the extremes.
The interiors are terminated in the ultimates or extremes.
Infernal Spirits, when devastated, are in the extremes of the Natural...
Falsity in the extremes, that is, in the Sensuous of man.
He thinks in the surface, that is, in the ultimates or extremes.
The Sensuous of man, or the Natural in the extremes...
To touch its extremity () = not even to the intermediates. Explained.
The extremes are the sensuous things which communicate with the world through (the senses). AC 9276, References. AC 9331:end, References.
They who are in the delights of external truth are the outermost ones... and close the Church.
The moth = the falsities in the extremes of man; and the worm = the evils there.
From the two extremities of the mercy seat () = celestial good and spiritual good. AC 9512. AC 9513.
Upon the edge of one curtain from the extremity in the joining () = the conjunction of the one sphere with the other. Explained. AC 9607.
The communication of all things of that Heaven with the extremes there. Signified.
To pass from extremity to extremity (), when said of the bar, by which is signified power, = the powers thence derived and everywhere continued.
At last the things in the extremes, which are the least perfect of all.
From extremity to extremity = the first and the last end, thus from beginning to end... (Thus) the extremities = all things, and everywhere. Illustrated.
But when the extremity only means the extreme or ultimate, it then = that which is ultimate of Heaven or the Church. Illustrated.
(Thus) extremity is predicated of good; and afar, of truth.
Upon its four extremities () = everywhere.
The ephod was the outermost of the three garments... That which is outermost not only holds together the interior things, but the interior things also cease in it.
The two extremities (), or to the right and to the left, = on all sides.
From the outermost things through which there is influx. Signified.
The conjunction of the whole of Heaven in the extremes. Signified.
Thou shalt place the two rings upon the two extremes of the breast-plate () = in the extremes... thus the conjunction of the sphere of the Divine good in the extremes of Heaven.
The two extremities of the two cords thou shalt place upon the two sockets () = the method of conjunction with the supporting things in the extremes.
The extremities = the ultimates or extremes.
Upon its fringes = in the extremes where the Natural is.
The extremes derive their essence from the interior things; and therefore when the interior things are unclean the extremes are also unclean, although the uncleanness may not appear to men.
The holy things of doctrine are in the extremes; and hearing and perception are also there.
Under Corner, see this reference.

The reason was that the horns were their extremes; and nothing of man is purified unless the extremes are purified; for the extremes are the things into which the interior things flow, and the influx takes place according to the state of them; and therefore if the extremes have been perverted, the interior things therein are perverted...
The extremes of man = all things belonging to him; and the extremes are the hands and feet.
The extremes which are in the body...

Nothing of them appears to man except what takes place in the extremes of the mind and in the extremes of the body; and how then can man claim what is Divine, merely because the few extremes appear to him as his?
Natural and temporary things are extremes and ultimates.
Those are called falsities in the extremes which are in the extremes of man's life, and are called sensuous things.

In the extremes, adulterous and conjugial caresses are perceived as alike, although in internals they are altogether unlike. Hence they are unlike in the extremes... The Angels distinguish in the extremes what is lascivious from what is not so...
At one extremity of the Spiritual World...
Such a man thinks in the extremes...
They thus undulate from one extreme to the other.
From afar, and from the extremity of the earth = those who are removed from the truths and goods of the Church. AE 294:3. AE 355:32. AE 422:5. AE 724:20.
The extremities of the earth which He has removed () = the falsities and evils which infest the Church, from which He has purified them.
The extremity of the earth = where that which is of the Church ceases to be.
The extremity of the earth = the ultimates of the Church. AE 406:5. AE 1133:3.
The boundary of Egypt = the extremes; for the extremes of the natural man are sensuous things.
By these things was represented that the extremes are preserved, because they = all things; for unless there are extremes the middle things are not preserved...
Occurs. AE 417:7.
Hope in extremity () = the end of the former Church, and the beginning of the New Church.
The health of the body depends on the state of the extremes...
In the last hours...
The inmost, middle, and outermost...
